类 AccessLibraryRepository

java.lang.Object
cn.vcampus.server.AccessLibraryRepository
所有已实现的接口:
LibraryCatalogV4, LibraryRepository
public final class AccessLibraryRepository extends Object implements LibraryRepository, LibraryCatalogV4
Access-backed library repository with atomic inventory and borrowing updates.
